name: Thesis Statement
description: Crafts focused, arguable, specific thesis statements for academic papers, essays, and dissertations. Distinguishes between descriptive and argumentative thesis types and tests for strength. Use when the user asks to write a thesis statement, develop a central argument, or create the core claim for an academic paper or essay. Do NOT use for full paper structure (use research-paper-structure), abstract writing (use abstract-writing), or non-academic arguments (use different writing skills).
